candidate.definition_en: A standard of perfection; a principle to be aimed at.
candidate.explanation_ar: المثل الأعلى أو النموذج اللي بنحاول نوصله.

senses.definition_en: A standard of perfection; a principle to be aimed at.
senses.explanation_ar: المثل الأعلى أو النموذج الذي يُسعى لتحقيقه.
examples: He considered justice to be the highest human ideal.
The small cottage represented her ideal of peaceful country living.
She worked hard to live up to that moral ideal.
